source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Load driver via command below $ sudo modprobe amdgpu ras_enable=1 2. Check amdgpu umc error count is zero via command below $ sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1 3. Execute the following command for Inject address/command parity error with single shot method: $ sudo amdgpuras -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

test_case.test_name: Address/Command Parity Uncorrectable Error Injection — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject one single-shot AMD GPU UMC address/command parity uncorrectable error on an explicitly approved accelerator, prove target-specific ACA/UMC reporting and the expected counter increment, then recover the GPU/host without repeating the destructive event.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and user-guide definitions for block0, subblock4, type4 and method1
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/model-to-device-index map and explicit injection target syntax
Explanation of why query uses `-d 0` while injection omits `-d`, and whether default targeting is permitted
Expected one-shot UMC counter delta and reconciliation of 38:00.0 versus 0c:00.0 plus one/two total example messages
Driver ras_enable current state and approved activation method without disrupting other GPUs/workloads
Expected ACA STATUS/ADDR/MISC/IPID/SYND, severity, containment, reset/recovery deadlines and restoration
